serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Oh! I thought you would never come out! I have been standing here for hours!
You: It’s been more like 6 minutes Big Daddy.
Big Daddy: Now that I checked my watch, you are right, sorry. It’s just that I’m always busy and I rarely have to be alone with my thoughts for so long so my perception of time is seriously fucked up.
Big Daddy: Alright, let’s go. An autonomous taxi is waiting for us.
You: Sure.
